USEFUL LANGUAGE FOR TODAY'S DISCUSSIONS — keep this in front of you and try to use a phrase from each row.
• Giving your view: In my view… / The way I see it… / I'd argue that…
• Agreeing: That's a fair point. / Exactly — and what's more…
• Disagreeing politely: I see what you mean, but… / I'm not so sure, because…
• Weighing options: On the one hand… on the other hand… / The main advantage / drawback is…
• Responding to others: So what you're saying is…? / You mentioned X — but doesn't that mean…?
• Concluding: All things considered… / On balance, I think…
